questions.question: What does chapter 12 record?
options: A record of the priestly families
A song of victory after the conquest
A list of the kings Israel defeated
A census of the fighting men
questions.answer: A list of the kings Israel defeated

questions.question: How many kings west of the Jordan did Joshua defeat, according to the summary?
